Linnea is a playable Geo character in Genshin Impact.

Raised among humans as one of the last Snowland Fae in Nod-Krai, as well as one of the last Augury Birds in existence,[8] Linnea currently works as an advisor to the Adventurers' Guild and as a naturalist.

Upon obtaining Linnea, the Gadget Linnea's Naturalist Archive may be obtained through the character menu, which includes the badge Unadorned and companion Companion: Exclusive.

Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms.

Tap

Super Power Form
Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler to attack nearby opponents continuously. Every attack will deal 2 instances of AoE Geo DMG.
If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will alternate between Pound-Pound Pummeler and Heavy Overdrive Hammer to continuously attack nearby opponents . Heavy Overdrive Hammer will deal AoE Geo DMG which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

Ultimate Power Form
Lumi will use the ultimate Million Ton Crush, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to Standard Power Form.

Standard Power Form
It might not be as flashy as the other forms, but it still packs a serious punch.
Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler at longer intervals to attack nearby opponents continuously. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance.

  • Linnea's Elemental Skill must be tapped 5 times in quick succession to activate Lumi's Ultimate Power Form.
    • Tapping 2-4 times is functionally identical to tapping one time.
  • Using Linnea's Elemental Skill or Burst while Lumi is already on the field will refresh her duration (25 seconds).
  • Lumi's attack frequency varies based on her form:
    • In Super Power Form, she will use Pound-Pound Pummeler every ~2 seconds, and Heavy Overdrive Hammer every ~5 seconds (if there are Moondrifts nearby).
      • Lumi will use Heavy Overdrive Hammer immediately after Moondrifts appear nearby. If Moondrifts are already on the field when Lumi is summoned in Super Power Form, her first attack will be Heavy Overdrive Hammer.
    • In Standard Power Form, Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler every ~5 seconds.
  • Lumi will not immediately generate Elemental Particles when summoned. Instead, she will generate 3 particles occasionally when she hits an enemy with an attack.
    • In Super Power Form, Lumi will generate particles on her first attack. Then:
      • If her first attack was Pound-Pound Pummeler, she will generate particles on every 4th Pound-Pound Pummeler attack afterwards.
      • If her first attack was Heavy Overdrive Hammer, she will generate particles on every 2nd Heavy Overdrive Hammer attack afterwards.
    • In Ultimate Power Form, Lumi will generate particles upon using Million Ton Crush. Then, after switching to Standard Power Form, she will generate particles on her 3rd and 5th attack.
  • In Co-Op Mode, only one instance of Lumi summoned by Linnea's Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst can exist at a time. The last player to summon Lumi will replace the already existing instance.‍[What about Lumi when summoned by Linnea's Utility Passive?]

4th Ascension Passive
Linnea will increase the Elemental Mastery of certain characters in your party according to your current active character. Increase in Elemental Mastery is based on 5% of Linnea's DEF. If your current active character:
  • Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.

Habitat Survey
Moonsign Benediction Passive
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
Master Adventurer
Utility Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her Aimed Shot is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
  • Specific animals: Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week.
  • Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.

The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.
  • The Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow has a charge time reduction of ?%.
  • The Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow can go through and hit entities within Thunder Barriers.
  • The Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow acts like an Omni-Ubiquity Net when it hits animals that can be captured by it. However, animals caught this way do not count toward the Zoo Tycoon achievements.
    • The Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow can only be successfully used as such 5 times per week. Afterward, all would-be successful uses act as failed uses of the Omni-Ubiquity Net (creatures are startled but not killed) and will trigger the following dialogue: Media:vo linnea talents 01.ogg I'm all out of nets... Better call it a week!
    • Upon successfully capturing an animal, the following text will appear on-screen: Come along, little one!
  • Lumi will only be dispatched to mine ore if the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow hits an ore used in forging (these ores are also the ones marked by other Utility Passives that they say mark ores used in forging). She will likewise only instantly mine such ores.
    • Lumi will neither be dispatched for nor instantly mine any other Geo objects, such as Local Specialties or the rocks encasing Geograna. However, Lumi can still deal damage to them if they are near an ore that is marked with the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow.
    • Lumi will only be dispatched for an ore marked with the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow if the player if within ?m of it.
    • The Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow will only mark an ore for a maximum of 8‍[ver­i­fi­ca­tion need­ed] seconds.
    • Only one ore can be marked at a time by the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow.
  • In Co-Op Mode, Lumi only collects ores for the player who dispatched her.
    • Ores for other players are also not grouped, despite the animation.
  • If the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow hits a target that can be marked or captured (even if unsuccessful), then it will not deal damage.
  • Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows are charged if Linnea begins charging her Charged Attack outside of combat.
    • If Linnea begins charging while in combat and then leaves combat without having fired the arrow she was charging, then that arrow will be a normal Charged Attack when it is fired, even if it is fully charged, and even if it finished charging outside of combat.
    • Likewise, if Linnea begins charging outside of combat and then fires that arrow after entering combat, the arrow will still be an Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow.
  • Lumi collects the ores in real time, matching the animation.
    • The player still has the option of collecting ores manually before Lumi collects them.
    • If Linnea dies or is swapped out of the party before all ores are collected, Lumi is immediately despawned and the player must manually collect the remaining ores, including any ores that were on their way to Lumi when she despawned.
